metadata_overrides.reason: Reviewed official vLLM base deliberately overrides this exact NCCL metadata pin; actual /etc/uv-overrides.txt and before-install inventory must agree.

opencv_shared_namespace.strategy: Keep both same-version metadata to satisfy both default requirement graphs; reinstall headless last without dependencies, and verify every hashed cv2 file from its RECORD plus actual import origin. Do not uninstall either distribution in a running Pod.

dependency_scope: Installed ai-dingo[video-gateway], ai-dingo-runtime, gpu-memory-service, vllm and vllm-omni default requirements plus recursively requested extras and named backend helpers. The complete ai-dingo[vllm] extra is not activated because its NIXL pin does not describe the inherited official vLLM 0.31 native stack.
validation_scope: Gateway framework dependency solve and synthetic CPU media checks precede framework license policy validation. Final adapter/source overlay is audited again offline. None establish H100/model/media E2E acceptance.
